text:
Alex: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the S3 degradation incident — putting the RCA link and action items in this thread so folks can pick owners. Thanks for the Qs earlier.

Maya: Can someone drop the RCA link? I missed the doc during the Q&A.

OpsBot: Incident 1832: severity=sev2, started=2026-09-10T09:12Z, resolved=2026-09-10T11:45Z. RCA draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1832-s3-degradation-draft (internal) :eyes:

Liam: Quick summary for folks who sent the questions: root cause = latent throttling in cross-region S3 replication queue + a retry storm from our canary clients. Two mitigations shipped: 1) temp rate-limiter at proxy, 2) adjusted client retry backoff.

Sarah: Thanks Alex & Liam. A few clarifications from leadership: we need an owner for long-term fixes (replication queue visibility + better throttling controls) and an owner for improving our canary/rate-limit interplay. Proposal: Devon -> long-term queue visibility; Katie -> canary and client backoff changes. Thoughts?

Devon: I'm happy to take queue visibility. First deliverable: instrumentation dashboard + alert for queue growth. I'll put a short plan in the tracker by EOD tomorrow.

Katie: I can own canary/backoff. Short-term: change default canary client backoff from linear to exponential + jitter. Timeline: roll on staging by Thursday, prod canary rollout Friday.

Maya: Who's doing the postmortem write-up and approvals? We need compliance sign-off.

Alex: I'll own the PM side and shepherd approvals. Plan: postmortem final by next Tue (2026-09-15). Compliance/Legal review requested by Tue end.

Liam: Action items I captured in the deck during the all-hands; mirroring here: 
- ACTION-1 [Devon]: Add queue metrics + alert (due 2026-09-17)
- ACTION-2 [Katie]: Canary client backoff + staging rollout (due 2026-09-11)
- ACTION-3 [Platform]: Add temporary dashboard on console for replication lag (owner: SRE team, due 2026-09-14)
- ACTION-4 [Alex]: Finalize RCA and get compliance sign-off (due 2026-09-15)

OpsBot: Deploy log: canary/backoff-change queued by CI at 2026-09-11T02:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/98321

Sarah: One more ask from leadership — evaluate whether dedicated capacity customers saw the same impact. If they did, we need a separate mitigation plan for Dedicated pools. Liam, can your team check by Friday?

Liam: Will do. I'll post findings to the RCA doc and ping here.

Katie: Quick question — do we want an automatic fallback policy if replication lag > X? We could route new model loads to same-region caches.

Alex: Good idea. Let's add that as a P0 optional mitigation in the RCA. If someone from product (cc @Maya) can estimate impact, we'll prioritize.

Maya: I'll scope impact estimate by Thurs EOD.

Devon: Also noting: need to add an e2e test that simulates throttled replication queue so we catch client retry storms in CI. I'll open an RFC tomorrow.

Katie: For transparency, adding the shared action tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-ActionTracker-INC1832 (internal) — please add your subtasks and mark status.

Alex: Thanks all. I'll update the all-hands follow-up doc and ping leadership once compliance signs off. If anyone needs a quick sync, I'll be in #eng-ops for the rest of the day. :thumbsup:
